package.name: astribot_slam_msgs
package.description: Message definitions for exposing voxel_slam's own keyframe poses (as corrected by its BTC loop closure, GTSAM/ISAM2 pose-graph optimization, and HBA global bundle adjustment) to downstream consumers such as nav_prob_grid — a Cartographer-style submap: each keyframe's point cloud is sent once, in its own local frame; its pose is republished whenever voxel_slam's own backend corrects it, without resending the cloud.
